GOD-RAYS THROUGH THE BROKEN ROOF: a soft fan of god-rays slanting down through the gap, spreading gently as they fall, resting in a warm bright pool across the green-furred floor below
ROUND PATCH UNDER THE OPEN DOME: a perfect circle of sunlight lying on the flagstones beneath the open dome, warm and still, the stone inside it glowing amber against the cool shade around it

DAPPLED LIGHT THROUGH FALLEN TIMBERS: soft dappled shapes of light falling through the gaps in the old timbers, lying in shifting golden patches across the mossy ground, trembling faintly with every breath of air

GOD-RAYS THROUGH THE BROKEN VAULT: a wide fan of god-rays slanting down through the broken vault, visible where the air holds its dust, the green floor below lit in long warm overlapping tongues of gold

AFTERNOON RAYS THROUGH THE COLLAPSED WALL: late afternoon light slanting in through the ragged opening where the wall has given way, spreading across the interior floor in a broad warm fan of soft gold

MORNING LIGHT THROUGH THE ROOF GAP: early morning god-rays reaching down through a single gap overhead, finding the old stone floor and lying there in a bright tender pool while the rest of the room rests in gentle dimness
SUN POURING THROUGH THE ARCH: warm sunlight pouring through the archway and lying long and gold across the mossy flagstones, the far land bright inside the opening, the whole threshold glowing

DOORWAY FULL OF GOLD: the ruined doorway filled entirely with late sunlight, the land beyond blazing softly in it, the light spilling forward across the threshold and lying warm on the first few stones inside
LOW SUN IN THE WINDOW OPENING: low sun filling the empty window opening completely, washing the deep stone sill gold and spilling a warm rectangle of light across the interior wall opposite
ARCH GLOW AT DAWN: the eastern archway glowing with the first full light of dawn, sunlight pouring through it in a slow warm flood and spreading across the courtyard floor in a long bright tongue

SIDE DOOR LIGHT ON THE FLOOR: sunlight slanting in through a narrow side doorway and lying in a bright warm stripe across the uneven floor, the edges of the stripe soft and golden where the light diffuses into shadow
RIPPLE LIGHT ON THE CEILING: sunlight bouncing off the green pool and rippling in slow bright nets across the stone above it, the whole ceiling alive with soft moving light

THE GLOWING POOL: sunlight reaching down into the shallow pool and making it glow from within, the water lit a warm jade green, the light rising up and washing the surrounding stones in soft reflected colour

SUNLIGHT DANCING ON THE SUBMERGED FLOOR: bright rippling sunlight dancing in soft wandering patches across the submerged floor of the flooded chamber, shifting and scattering with the faint movement of the water above
WATER LIGHT ON THE VAULT: light rippling off the flooded lower room and travelling up the walls to play across the curved vault overhead in slow wandering nets of gold and pale green
AFTERNOON POOL GLOW: afternoon sun catching the still interior pool at a low angle and sending a broad wash of warm reflected light trembling up across the nearest wall, the stone lit amber and alive
MOTES IN THE MORNING LIGHT: dust turning slowly where the morning light reaches down through the gap, each mote bright for a moment as it drifts, the lit air around them glowing soft and golden
POLLEN DRIFTING BRIGHT: pollen drifting in through the open roof and catching the light as it falls, each particle glowing briefly gold before drifting on, the lit air thick with slow soft brightness

DUST AND LIGHT TOGETHER: motes of dust and fine pollen turning together where the sunlight reaches into the still interior, the air in that one place glowing softly, warm and luminous and full of gentle motion
ONE LIT STAIR TREAD: a single bright patch of sunlight caught on one stair tread alone, the rest of the flight in soft shade, that one step warm and gold as if chosen, as if blessed
WARM BAND ALONG THE WALL TOP: a lit band of sunlight running all along the top of the long interior wall while the base of the wall rests in cool shadow, the line between them sharp and lovely
SUN ON THE MOSSY STEP: one warm patch of sun lying across a mossy step, the green moss lit bright gold where the light touches it, the colour vivid and rich against the surrounding shade

FAR END OF THE PASSAGE GLOWING: the far end of the long passage glowing gold where the light pours in from beyond, the glow drawing the eye forward through the gentle dark toward that warm bright distance

TOP STONE STILL LIT: the top of the tallest standing stone still holding the last of the evening light while everything below has gone cool and blue, that high surface glowing soft amber against the darkening sky

MOONLIGHT IN THE COURTYARD: moonlight washing the open courtyard in a cool silver flood, the pale stone glowing under it, every worn surface luminous and still, the whole enclosure serene and softly radiant
